title: An attacker can trigger a large memory use by cancelling QUIC streams while DNSdist is retrieving the… (CVE-2026-85564)
description: CVE-2026-85564 is a vulnerability in DNSdist where an attacker can cause excessive memory usage by cancelling QUIC streams while DNSdist is retrieving backend responses. The memory allocated for the cancelled streams is not released immediately but retained until the QUIC connection ends, leading to increased memory consumption.
